properties.name: Eastern Ontario
properties.source: Eastern Ontario (owner, Oct 11: option A; then "the boundary shouldn't be a staircase"; then "make the Ottawa - Ontario border straight vertical like most boundaries"): everything east of 77.9°W — the middle of the slanted line he had liked (Ottawa River at the Renfrew/Nipissing corner to the Bay of Quinte), so the two sides keep about the same land. It meets the Ottawa River above Rolphton and Lake Ontario by Brighton: Ottawa, the Ottawa Valley, Kingston, Belleville, Trenton and Prince Edward County are east of it; Peterborough and Cobourg west. The shape runs on over Quebec, the US and the lake, which it never cuts: only the province's own land (CA-ON) is.
